<font size="6">第二部分&nbsp;&nbsp;安装说明</font><br>
<font size="5">电脑版：</font><ul><li><font size="5">打开通达信菜单——公式系统——公式管理器（Ctrl+F）</font></li><li><font size="5">点击新建，复制以上代码粘贴到编辑器里，填写公式名称，点击确定</font></li><li><font size="5">选择对应的指标：主图和副图指标可以直接在分钟线输入公式名称的首字母+回车；如果是分时指标：在分时图上右键选择分时指标——选择对应的指标点确定</font><br>
</li></ul><font size="5">手机版：</font><ul><li><font size="5">在手机版通达信指标名称处点击——点击新增——输入指标名称——粘贴指标代码——点击右上角保存，这样指标就添加成功了</font></li><li><font size="5">在手机版通达信指标名称处点击——选择对应的指标，这样就能启用该指标了。</font><br>
</li></ul><br>
<div align="left"><br>
<font size="6">第三部分 指标使用说明</font></div><div align="left"><font size="5">一、通达信主图+副图+选股指标；</font></div><font size="5">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;主图含DYNAINFO即时行情函数；</font><br>
<font size="5">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;副图含FINANCE、BARSNEXT、FILTERX函数；</font><br>
<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><font size="5">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;打分指标不含未来函数；</font></font><br>
<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><font size="5">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;选股指标不含未来函数；</font></font><br>
<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><font size="5">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;手机、电脑通用。</font></font><font size="5"><br>
</font><font size="5">二、操作经验总结：对于副图2打分排序里的九封资金占比这个数值，可参考以下划分：<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 1、当资金占比超过15%以上：个股总体位置较低时，意味着主力资金过于介入明显在大概率在近期会有一波拉伸；<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 2、资金占比处于5%-15%之间：代表当日个股主力资金介入处于一个异动状态；<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 3、资金占比低于5%：一般不考虑此信号操作。</font><font size="5"><br>
</font><font size="5">三、九封精选：适用于当天盘中预警介入（注：对指标信号有一定程度熟悉后近期行情处于趋势向上可采用此方法）<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;九封初选：适用于尾盘2：30分选股 然后打分排名第1介入，资金占比超5%以上（注：2：30分初选选好个股后，确认好操作个股后，建议在收盘前2：50分后再介入这样可达到风险最小一个状态）</font><font size="5"><br>
</font><font size="6">第四部分&nbsp;&nbsp;主图/副图公式&nbsp;&nbsp;手机/电脑</font><font style="color:rgb(128, 99, 194)"><font face="system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;"><font size="5"><br>
</font></font></font><font style="color:rgb(128, 99, 194)"><font face="system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;"><font size="5">一、主图源码</font></font></font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR,0.4,0,0,HYBLOCK),COLORYELLOW;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR,0.45,0,0,DYBLOCK),COLORYELLOW;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR,0.5,0,0,GNBLOCK),COLORRED;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(ISLASTBAR,0.4,0.03,0,FGBLOCK),COLORMAGENTA;

STICKLINE(C/REF(C,1)&gt;=1.097 AND H&gt;L AND H=C,C,O,3,0),COLORMAGENTA;

STICKLINE(REF(C,1)/C&gt;=1.097 AND H&gt;L AND H=C,C,O,3,0),COLORLIBLUE;

STICKLINE(H/REF(C,1)&gt;=1.097 AND H&gt;C AND H=C,H,C,0,0),COLORMAGENTA;

STICKLINE(REF(C,1)/L&gt;=1.097 AND H&gt;L AND H=C,C,L,0,0),COLORLIBLUE; 

AAV:=VOL/((H-L)*2-ABS(C-O));

KKPU1:=IF(C&gt;OPEN,AAV*(HIGH-LOW),IF(C&lt;OPEN,AAV*((HIGH-OPEN)+(C-LOW)),VOL/2)),NODRAW;

KKPU2:=IF(C&gt;OPEN,0-AAV*((HIGH-C)+(OPEN-LOW)),IF(C&lt;OPEN,0-AAV*(HIGH-LOW),0-VOL/2)),NODRAW;

净流入:=(KKPU1+KKPU2)/99,NODRAW;

KKPU3:=(C/REF(C,1)-1)*100;

DRAWTEXT(净流入&gt;=200 AND KKPU3&gt;=3,L*0.995,VARCAT(VARCAT('净买:',VAR2STR(净流入,0)),'万')),COLORYELLOW;

DRAWTEXT(净流入&lt;-200 AND KKPU3&lt;=-2,H*1.01,VARCAT(VARCAT('流出:',VAR2STR(净流入,0)),'万')),COLORGREEN;

AP:=AMOUNT/10000;

占比:=净流入/AP*100,NODRAW;

DRAWTEXT(净流入&gt;=200 AND KKPU3&gt;=3 AND 占比&gt;=15 ,L*0.965,VARCAT(VARCAT('占比:',VAR2STR(占比,0)),'%')),COLORMAGENTA;

DRAWRECTREL(920,850,1000,1000,RGB(255,0,255)),NOFRAME;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.92,0.85,0,' 2025版 涨停至尊版'),COLORWHITE;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.94,0.9,0,'★九封至尊★'),COLORWHITE;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.92,0.95,0,'适用※盘中预警 ※ 尾盘'),COLORBLUE;

A:=(C/REF(C,1)-1)*100&gt;9.82 AND H=C AND H&lt;&gt;L,NODRAW;

B:=BARSLAST(A),NODRAW;

B1:=REF(BARSLAST(A),1),NODRAW;

AO:=REF(C,B),NODRAW;

XX2:=CROSS(C,AO) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1)  AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10 NODRAW;

XX2A:=FILTER(XX2,30);

KMJNHB1:=AO-0.01,NODRAW;

XX2B:=CROSS(C,KMJNHB1) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1)  AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10  AND H=C;

KMJNHB2:=FILTER(XX2B,30),COLORMAGENTA;

A3P:=REF(O,B);

A3A:=A3P+(AO-A3P)*0.7,NODRAW;

XX2C:=CROSS(C,A3A) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1) AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10 ;

KMJNHBP:=FILTER(XX2C,30),COLORMAGENTA;

九封至尊:XX2A OR KMJNHB2 OR KMJNHBP,NODRAW;

UUJ:=COUNT(A,10)&gt;=2;{19}

九封精选:FILTER(XX2C AND UUJ,30),NODRAW;

STICKLINE(XX2A OR KMJNHB2 OR KMJNHBP, O,C, 3,0),COLORYELLOW;

STICKLINE(XX2A OR KMJNHB2 OR KMJNHBP, C,H, 0,0),COLORYELLOW;

STICKLINE(XX2A OR KMJNHB2 OR KMJNHBP, O,L, 0,0),COLORYELLOW;

DRAWTEXT(XX2A OR KMJNHB2 OR KMJNHBP  ,L*0.98,'九封至尊'),COLORMAGENTA;

MB1:=MA(C,5),COLORYELLOW;

AB:=(H-MB1)/MB1*100;

抛点:=(H-MB1)/MB1*100&gt;=20 AND H&gt;C;

DRAWTEXT(抛点,H*1.02,'抛'),COLORGREEN;

减点:=AB&gt;=15 AND AB&lt;20 AND H&gt;C;

A1:=FILTER(减点,12);

DRAWTEXT(A1,H*1.02,'减'),COLORGREEN;

MB1A:=MA(C,3),COLORYELLOW;

MB2:EMA(MB1A,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

MB3:EMA(MB2,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

MB4:EMA(MB3,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

MB5:=EMA(MB4,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

MB6:=EMA(MB5,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

MB7:=EMA(MB6,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

MB8:=EMA(MB7,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

MB9:=EMA(MB8,2),COLORBLUE,DOTLINE;

Q1:IF(MB1A&gt;MB2,MB2,DRAWNULL),COLORYELLOW,LINETHICK2;

CRFDES5:=DYNAINFO(88)/10000,NODRAW;

CRFDES6:=DYNAINFO(7),NODRAW;

STICKLINE(C/REF(C,1)&gt;=1.097  AND H=C AND CRFDES6=C,C,O,3,0), COLORMAGENTA;

KK:=(C/REF(C,1)-1)*100&gt;9.8 AND H=C AND H&lt;&gt;L,COLORMAGENTA;

DRAWTEXT(CRFDES6=C AND KK ,L*1.035,VARCAT(VAR2STR(CRFDES5,0),'万★封单资金')),COLORWHITE;

CRFDES8:=DYNAINFO(88)/DYNAINFO(10)*100,NODRAW;

DRAWTEXT(CRFDES6=C AND KK ,L*1.01,VARCAT(VAR2STR(CRFDES8+5,0),'★系数')),COLORGREEN;</pre></div><br>
<font color="#8063c2"><font size="5">二、副图1源码</font></font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">AC:=REF(O,B),NODRAW;

上跌价:=REF((AC+AO)*0.5,QI)NODRAW;

KKPL6:=IF(XX2A AND H&gt;L,上跌价,0)NODRAW;

KKPL7:=IF(KMJNHB2 ,(AC+AO)*0.5,0)NODRAW;

DRAWTEXT(XX2A ,3,VARCAT(VARCAT('止跌价:',VAR2STR(KKPL6,2)),'元')),COLORGREEN;

DRAWTEXT(KMJNHB2 ,3,VARCAT(VARCAT('止跌价:',VAR2STR(KKPL7,2)),'元')),COLORGREEN;

MB1:=MA(C,5),COLORYELLOW;

QQ7:=MA(C,144);

AB:=(H-MB1)/MB1*100;

NHYT:=(H-MB1)/MB1*100&gt;=20 AND H&gt;C;

TGVFR:=AB&gt;=15 AND AB&lt;20 AND H&gt;C;

A1:=FILTER(TGVFR,12);

STICKLINE(NHYT, 0,5.8, 0,0),COLORGREEN;

STICKLINE(NHYT, 5,6, 3,0),COLORGREEN;

DRAWICON(NHYT,6,9);

DRAWTEXT(NHYT,6.5,   VARCAT(VAR2STR(MB1*1.2,2),'元★抛')),COLORGREEN;

YTGHJN1:=AMOUNT/VOL/100,NODRAW;

YTGHJN2:=O&gt;C AND YTGHJN1&gt;REF(C,1),COLORRED,NODRAW;

STICKLINE(YTGHJN2,O,C,1,0),COLORGREEN,NODRAW;

YTGHJN5:=C/REF(C,1)&lt;=0.96 AND V&lt;HHV(V,30)/1.9,COLORGREEN,NODRAW;

D:=GPJYVALUE(2,1,0);

E:=GPJYVALUE(2,2,0);

BB:=D-E;

AA:=D+E;

F:=AMO/10000,NODRAW;

BB1:=-F*0.2+BB;

CRFDES31:=IF(BB&gt;0,BB,DRAWNULL);

CRFDES3:=IF(AA&gt;0,AA,DRAWNULL);

CRFDES1:=(C/REF(C,1)-1)*100;

AAV:=VOL/((H-L)*2-ABS(C-O));

KKPL3:=IF(C&gt;OPEN,AAV*(HIGH-LOW),IF(C&lt;OPEN,AAV*((HIGH-OPEN)+(C-LOW)),VOL/2)),NODRAW;

KKPL4:=IF(C&gt;OPEN,0-AAV*((HIGH-C)+(OPEN-LOW)),IF(C&lt;OPEN,0-AAV*(HIGH-LOW),0-VOL/2)),NODRAW;

净流入:=(KKPL3+KKPL4)/99,NODRAW;

KKPL2:=(C-REF(C,1))/REF(C,1)*100;

KKPL1:=VOL*10000/FINANCE(7); 

DRAWTEXT(NHYT AND 净流入&lt;0,3,VARCAT(VARCAT('净流入:',VAR2STR(净流入,0)),'万')),COLORGREEN;

DRAWTEXT(NHYT AND 净流入&gt;0,3,VARCAT(VARCAT('净流入:',VAR2STR(净流入,0)),'万')),COLORRED;

A3:=SUM(KKPL1,3),COLORRED;

A5:=SUM(KKPL1,5),COLORRED;

A13:=SUM(KKPL1,13),COLORRED;

三日KKPL:=SUM(净流入,3),COLORRED;

五日KKPL:=SUM(净流入,5),COLORCYAN;

十三日KKPL:=SUM(净流入,13),COLORMAGENTA;

二一日KKPL:=SUM(净流入,21),COLORMAGENTA;

三四日KKPL:=SUM(净流入,34),COLORMAGENTA;

五五日KKPL:=SUM(净流入,55),COLORMAGENTA;

DRAWRECTREL(920,500,1000,200,RGB(255,0,255)),NOFRAME;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.92,0.05,0,'当天净流入:'){19};

DRAWNUMBER_FIX(1,0.965,0.05,0,CONST(净流入)),COLORRED;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.99,0.05,0,'万');

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.92,0.2,0,'3天净流入:');

DRAWNUMBER_FIX(1,0.965,0.2,0,CONST(三日KKPL)),COLORWHITE;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.99,0.2,0,'万');

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.92,0.35,0,'5天净流入:');

DRAWNUMBER_FIX(1,0.965,0.35,0,CONST(五日KKPL)),COLORWHITE;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.99,0.35,0,'万');

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.92,0.5,0,'13天净流入:');

DRAWNUMBER_FIX(1,0.965,0.5,0,CONST(十三日KKPL)),COLORRED;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.99,0.5,0,'万');

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.92,0.65,0,'21天净流入:');

DRAWNUMBER_FIX(1,0.965,0.65,0,CONST(二一日KKPL)),COLORRED;

DRAWTEXT_FIX(1,0.99,0.65,0,'万');

<font color="#8063c2"><font size="5">三、副图2源码</font></font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">AAV:=VOL/((H-L)*2-ABS(C-O));

KKPU3:=IF(C&gt;OPEN,AAV*(HIGH-LOW),IF(C&lt;OPEN,AAV*((HIGH-OPEN)+(C-LOW)),VOL/2));

KKPU4:=IF(C&gt;OPEN,0-AAV*((HIGH-C)+(OPEN-LOW)),IF(C&lt;OPEN,0-AAV*(HIGH-LOW),0-VOL/2));

九封资金:(KKPU3+KKPU4)/99;

AP:=AMOUNT/10000;

九封资金占比:九封资金/AP*100;</pre></div><br>
<font color="#8063c2"><font face="system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;"><font size="5">四、副图3源码</font></font></font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">VAR11:=EMA(MA(C,5),5);

QQ:=(VAR11-REF(VAR11,1))/REF(VAR11,1)*10000,NODRAW;

A10:=CROSS(QQ,0);

WW:=IF(A10,5,0),COLORYELLOW;

STICKLINE(QQ&gt;REF(QQ,1) AND QQ&gt;0,0,QQ,1,0),COLORRED;

主力介入:IF(QQ&gt;REF(QQ,1) AND QQ&gt;0,QQ,0),COLORRED,NODRAW;

VAR2:=100*WINNER(CLOSE*0.95);

STICKLINE(VAR2&gt;50 AND COST(85)&lt;CLOSE AND QQ&gt;0,0,QQ,1,0);

</font></font></font><font size="6">第五部分&nbsp;&nbsp;选股公式&nbsp;&nbsp;手机/电脑</font><br>
<font face="system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;"><font size="5"><font color="#9932cc">一、九封初选源码</font></font></font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">{九封初选}

A:=(C/REF(C,1)-1)*100&gt;9.82 AND H=C AND H&lt;&gt;L;

B:=BARSLAST(A);

AO:=REF(C,B);

KMJNHB3:=AO-0.01;

B1:=REF(BARSLAST(A),1);

XX2:=CROSS(C,AO) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1) AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10;

XX2A:=FILTER(XX2,30);

XX2B:=CROSS(C,KMJNHB3) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1) AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10  AND H=C;

KMJNHB2:=FILTER(XX2B,30);

A3P:=REF(O,B);

A3A:=A3P+(AO-A3P)*0.7;

XX2C:=CROSS(C,A3A) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1) AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10;

KMJNHBP:=FILTER(XX2C,30);

九封初选:XX2A OR KMJNHB2 OR KMJNHBP;</pre></div><br>
<font size="5"><font color="#9932cc">二、九封精选源码</font></font><br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[Asm] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: asm; gutter: true">{九封精选}

A:=(C/REF(C,1)-1)*100&gt;9.82 AND H=C AND H&lt;&gt;L;

B:=BARSLAST(A);

AO:=REF(C,B);

KMJNHB3:=AO-0.01;

B1:=REF(BARSLAST(A),1);

UUJ:=COUNT(A,10)&gt;=2;

XX2:=CROSS(C,AO) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1) AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10 AND UUJ ;

XX2A:=FILTER(XX2,30) ;

XX2B:=CROSS(C,KMJNHB3) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1) AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10  AND H=C AND UUJ;

KMJNHB2:=FILTER(XX2B,30);

A3P:=REF(O,B);

A3A:=A3P+(AO-A3P)*0.7;

XX2C:=CROSS(C,A3A) AND C&gt;O AND C&gt;REF(C,1) AND B1&gt;=3 AND B1&lt;=10 AND UUJ;

九封精选:FILTER(XX2C,30);</pre></div><br>
<br>
<strong><font size="5">注意事项：</font></strong><br>
<font size="5">1、复制安装的时候主图、副图和选股公式分开复制，分开安装；</font><br>
<font size="5">2、复制安装的时候出现错误提示，首先找到错误提示的代码，然后把代码里面出现的“ ？”删除；</font><br>
<font size="5">3、复制安装的时候出现错误提示，按错误提示找到代码的位置，重点看一下代码“AND”和“OR”是不是缺少空格的情况。</font><br>
<font size="5">4、如果源码复制不通过，可以用浏览器打开后再复制到WORD文档里，再从WORD文档里复制粘贴到通达信进行安装即可。</font><br>
<font size="5"><font color="#ff0000">5、其他事项我也爱莫能助，我也是菜鸟一个，仅作分享，求大佬指点。</font></font><br>
